briefdescription.para: Check a given position in the expression for the presence of a hex value.

detaileddescription.para:
a_szExpr
Pointer to the expression string
[in/out]
a_iPos Pointer to an integer value holding the current parsing position in the expression.
a_fVal
Pointer to the position where the detected value shall be stored.
Hey values must be prefixed with "0x" in order to be detected properly.
Call ParserBase class constructor and trigger Function, Operator and Constant initialization.

This version of the parser handles only integer numbers. It disables the built in operators thus it is slower than muParser. Integer values are stored in the double value_type and converted if needed.
